TAB: Note: perks are ordered from top to bottom in order of endgame applicability and aren't necessarily directly associated with their corresponding perk in the other column (i.e. top+top perk). Also, S tier is individual to each tier list (S tier glaive =/= S tier sniper in overall viability).
